notes.title: DEVLOG #8
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/1ec41be3ff45208d94a8f4253ac54d26b70faa0f.png

Greetings !

This is (hopefully) the last devlog before the game comes out.

It's about weapon upgrades for levels on the boat.


There will be 4 in total and each can be upgraded multiple times.

1. Rapid-fire gun
Fires multiple rounds in a row. At maximum level one of the shots will be enhanced.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/3abfdeb54f001fbd14f5b2feeb921bfb860bb9e9.gif

2. Paired Pistols
Fires two powerful projectiles at once.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/c16187f83ead2b3ba659cd5cfbe12b994d743d54.gif

3. Blunderbuss
Fires multiple projectiles. More shells are fired as you upgrade.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/be85204ebdb1da850e0cfeae27ed9ed8aeb693f7.gif

4. Parrot Cage
Fires a homing mechanical parrot that flies at the nearest enemy. With upgrade, an explosion appears on contact with the enemy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/bad1876629c3562c5e247482d7f3f66b5824efda.gif

That's all for now. 
🌴Thank you for your attention. 🌴

notes.title: Corsair`s Madness Prologue: Jungle`s Island RELEASE on 3.02
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43131581/ad38149604c7ee12a28b9683fc5fbdbd50e60608.png

Hey everyone, it's time to share the release date of the prologue. 

On Friday, 3.02, you can finally try out an entire island to explore!
What awaits you as early as TOMORROW:

 The story's plot
 5 levels
 3 bosses
 Playing as a character with two different combat systems
 Puzzle solving
 Boat battles
 Equipment upgrades
